reuse.why: Edits the single shared getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; both branches collapse to amount - threshold and Math.min in the one definition.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, which every consumer already calls.

scope.why: Only the rule and the tests describing it change (one test title is merely reworded).

maintainability.why: Smaller, clearer rule with tests updated to the new semantics.
